## Purpose

The symposium will bring our community together, spark interdisciplinary dialogue, and highlight software and modelling tools that may be useful across multiple disciplines.

## Who Can Attend

Academic staff, research staff, professional staff, postdoctoral researchers, and postgraduate students are welcome. 

Presentations should highlight research that has benefited from modelling or software tools and may inspire or assist people in other disciplines.

## Confirmed Invited Speakers

- **Tulasi Parashar**, School of Chemical and Physical Sciences — *How not to use HPC*
- **Stephen Skalicky**, School of Linguistics and Applied Language Studies — *What can LLMs bring to the debate about literal and figurative meaning?*
- **Marcus Frean**, School of Engineering and Computer Science — *Healthy tissue as an associative memory*
- **Alanna Alevropoulos-Borrill**, Antarctic Research Centre — *From Ice Sheets to Global Climate: Understanding Change in Antarctica with Numerical Models*
- **Adam Crisp**, Research Office — *AI assisted App build to remove repetitive tasks*
- **David Roberts**, Digital Solutions — *From Idea to Insight – using Copilot in your research project*
